transport: USB (integrated cable) into any GX device running Venus OS v2.60+ · no protocol of its own · host GX publishes it on D-Bus as com.victronenergy.modem · readable over that GX's MQTT broker at N/<VRM portal ID>/modem/0/<D-Bus path> (1883 plain / 8883 TLS, off by default) · NOT present in the GX Modbus TCP register list
blocks: D-Bus service com.victronenergy.modem, read-only unless noted: /Model, /IMEI, /NetworkName, /NetworkType, /SignalStrength, /Roaming, /Connected, /IP, /SimStatus, /RegStatus, /PPPStatus, /Debug (writable). Settings under localsettings: /Settings/Modem/Connect (0/1), /Settings/Modem/RoamingPermitted (0/1), /Settings/Modem/PIN, /Settings/Modem/APN, /Settings/Modem/User, /Settings/Modem/Password. Enums: SimStatus 10=SIM not inserted, 11=SIM PIN required, 12=SIM PUK required, 13=SIM failure, 14=SIM busy, 15=SIM wrong, 16=incorrect password, 1000=ready, 1001=unknown error (values <1000 otherwise are 3GPP TS 27.007 §9.2 error codes). RegStatus = +CREG codes per 3GPP TS 27.007 §7.2: 0=not registered/not searching, 1=registered home, 2=not registered/searching, 3=registration denied, 4=unknown, 5=registered roaming. PPPStatus 0=down, 1=init, 2=up. NetworkType 0=NONE,1=GSM,2=GPRS,3=EDGE,4=UMTS,5=HSDPA,6=HSUPA,7=HSPA,8=LTE,9=TDS-CDMA,10=TDS-HSDPA,11=TDS-HSUPA,12=TDS-HSPA,13=CDMA,14=EVDO,15=CDMA/EVDO,16=CDMA/LTE,23=eHRPD,24=CDMA/eHRPD,30=HSPA+. Separately, the built-in GPS receiver lands on com.victronenergy.gps, which IS in the Modbus TCP map at 2800 latitude / 2802 longitude / 2804 course / 2805 speed / 2806 fix / 2807 satellites / 2808 altitude.
sharedMapEvidence: One vendor table carries both models: GX LTE 4G manual rev 04 - 09/2024, §1.1, columns 'Part number \| Name \| Region \| Used module \| Supported LTE bands' — GSM100100400 = GX LTE 4G-E (SIMCom SIM7600E), GSM100200400 = GX LTE 4G-A (SIMCom SIM7600A), GSM100300400 = GX LTE 4G-SA (SIMCom SIM7600SA). The three differ only in radio bands. Victron's own dbus-modem README lists its supported modules as
gotchas: BUY THE RIGHT REGION. GX LTE 4G-E (GSM100100400) is the EMEA model: LTE bands 1, 3, 5, 7, 8, 20, 38, 40, 41. GX LTE 4G-A (GSM100200400) is the North America model: bands 2, 4, 12. A Quebec retailer stocking the 4G-E is stocking a unit that will likely never register on Bell/Telus/Rogers. Vendor table, GX LTE 4G manual

/SignalStrength is 0–31, the raw AT+CSQ scale, stated as '(0-31)' in the vendor README. MetricKind::LinkSignalQuality is Unit::Percent. A driver must rescale, and there is no vendor-stated conversion. Do not publish 0–31 into a percent field.

com.victronenergy.modem IS NOT IN THE MODBUS TCP REGISTER LIST. Verified by parsing the committed workbook docs/victron-gx-modbus-tcp-register-list.xlsx: its 1008 registers span exactly 33 dbus-service-names and 'modem' is not one of them; a case-insensitive search of the whole shared-strings table for modem/gsm/lte/ce

com.victronenergy.modem is ALSO absent from Victron's own Venus D-Bus wiki (github.com/victronenergy/venus/wiki/dbus), which documents 35 com.victronenergy.* services and not this one. The dbus-modem README is the only vendor documentation of these paths. Contradiction recorded rather than resolved.

MQTT device instance is 0, and that is derived from vendor source code, not from vendor prose. dbus-modem.py registers VeDbusService('com.victronenergy.modem') and adds no /DeviceInstance and no /ProductId path. dbus-flashmq's get_instance_from_items() (src/utils.cpp) initialises deviceInstance = 0, looks for /DeviceIn
unmappedReports: /NetworkType — 21-value radio-access-technology enum (GSM…LTE…HSPA+). No MetricKind and no ValueKind for it., /RegStatus — network registration state (+CREG 0–5). No MetricKind; ValueKind::RunState is the wrong domain., /PPPStatus — data-link state (down/init/up). No MetricKind., /SimStatus — SIM health, 3GPP error codes plus 1000/1001. No MetricKind, no ValueKind., /Roaming — 0/1. No MetricKind. Matters for a cabin on a metered SIM., /NetworkName — operator name, a string. No MetricKind, and MetricValue has no String variant at all., /Model, /IMEI, /IP — device metadata, all strings. Same missing String variant. Arguably correct to have no MetricKind., link-downlink and link-uplink have no source here — the modem measures no throughput, it only reports link state and RSSI. A GX-fronted cellular link cannot fill the two MetricKinds cabin-starlink fills., GPS from the built-in receiver (com.victronenergy.gps 2800–2808: latitude, longitude, course, speed, satellites, altitude) — no MetricKind. Already recorded in docs/catalog/lan-http.md; repeated because the GX LTE is what populates it., /Settings/Modem/Connect is a writable 0/1 that raises and drops the data connection. No CommandKind fits — set-switch means a relay. Recording it as a contract gap rather than claiming set-switch.
